title: Let's Learn English Lesson 28
subtitle: I Passed It!
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 28: I Passed It! (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! Guess what this is? This is my driver's license! I passed my driving test!
dialogue.zh: 嗨！猜猜這是什麼？這是我的駕照！我通過了駕駛考試！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today, I rented a car so I can drive around Washington, D.C. You can see more of the city this way. Marsha!
dialogue.zh: 今天我租了一輛車，這樣就能開車逛華盛頓特區。這樣可以看到更多這座城市。瑪莎！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, did you get your driver's license?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I did! But it was not easy.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Why? What happened?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, you know, I can drive farm equipment really well. But I was really nervous driving in Washington, D.C. traffic!
dialogue.zh: 嗯，你知道，我開農用機械很在行。可在華盛頓特區開車我真的很緊張！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Did you pass the test the first time?
dialogue.zh: 你第一次就通過考試了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well…no. But I did pass the second time.
dialogue.zh: 嗯……沒有。不過第二次我通過了。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: What happened during the first test?
dialogue.zh: 第一次考試發生了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It started fine.

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: Okay … Anna. Is your seatbelt buckled?
dialogue.zh: 好……安娜。安全帶繫好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, sir!

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: Great. Please start the car.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay, Anna, start the car. Started the car. Good job, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 好，安娜，發動汽車。發動了。幹得好，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: Why are you talking to yourself?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am a little nervous. When I'm nervous, I talk to myself.
dialogue.zh: 我有點緊張。緊張的時候，我會自言自語。

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: You don't need to be nervous.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Listen to that engine!

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: Please, stop pushing the gas pedal!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sorry.

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: Okay, when you are ready, turn.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Great!

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: Not now! You almost hit that car!
dialogue.zh: 現在不行！你差點撞到那輛車！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You said "turn!"

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: Look first! There were cars in the street.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Please don't yell at me!

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: I'm sorry! I was afraid.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You were yelling.

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: Look out for that car! Brake! Brake!!

dialogue.speaker: Anna and John
dialogue.en: Ahhh!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Why is everyone honking at us?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼大家都在對我們按喇叭？

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: You were driving too slow! Anna, stay on the street!
dialogue.zh: 你開得太慢了！安娜，留在路上！

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: Hands on the wheel, Anna.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What's that sound?

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.en: That, Anna, is the police.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: That sounds awful.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, it did not go well. But, I practiced and passed the second time!
dialogue.zh: 是的，第一次很不順利。不過我練習了，第二次通過了！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Do you know where you want to take your first drive in Washington, D.C.?
dialogue.zh: 你知道第一次在華盛頓特區想開去哪裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes! Let's go!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: There it is … the White House!

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, you do know you can't drive up to the White House, don't you?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你知道不能開車一直開到白宮門口，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. No. I didn't know. I guess we walk from here!
dialogue.zh: 知道。不知道。我不知道。我想我們從這兒走過去！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sometimes you can see more of Washington, D.C. in a car. If you want to see the White House, you need to walk. Until next time … !
dialogue.zh: 有時候開車能看到更多華盛頓特區。不過要想看白宮，你得走路。下次見……！

quiz.prompt: When did Anna pass the driving test?
Why do Anna and Marsha walk at the end?
choices: The car ran out of gas
They cannot drive up to the White House
